questions.stem: Arrange the following afferent columns in the floor of the fourth ventricle from medial to lateral?General somatic EfferentSpecial somatic AfferentSpecial somatic EFferentSpecial visceral EfferentSelect the correct answer from the given below code:
questions.solutionHtml:
a, d, b, c
  • From medial to lateral ,the afferent columns in the floor of the fourth ventricle are general visceral,special visceral,general somatic,special somatic.

questions.stemHtml: Which of the following statements given below regarding the muscle shown in the image are correct?They Retract the scapula along with middle fibers of trapezius.They elevate the scapula along with fibers of trapezius.They rotate the scapula tilting the glenoid cavity inferiorly.They rotate the scapula tilting the glenoid cavity superiorlySelect the correct answer from the given below code:
questions.solutionHtml:
1,2,3 are correct statement
  • The muscles marked in the above image are rhomboids minor and major. These muscles cause retraction and elevation of the scapula and they rotate the scapula tilting the glenoid cavity inferiorly.
